name: Advanced Info Service Public Company Limited
summary: Advanced Info Service Public Company Limited operates as a telecommunications company primarily in Thailand. The company operates through three segments: Mobile Phone Services, Mobile Phone and Equipment Sales, and Datanet and Broadband Services.
